product_one_liner.value: Bitly helps brands and businesses create, manage, and measure branded links and QR codes to track digital interactions across online and offline channels.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists Bitly's company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists the headquarters as New York, NY.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering blog includes technical posts about Bitly's Go backend and NSQ message-processing infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: Bitly has a public developer portal with API documentation and other developer resources.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed job titles included software engineering and data engineering roles, but none had a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Bitly's Assist FAQ, product information, blog, privacy materials, and security/subprocessor portal did not publicly identify the underlying model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Bitly publicly claims SOC 2 compliance and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports a $63 million Series D on July 12, 2017; Spectrum's report characterizes the $63 million transaction as a sale of a majority stake.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round was July 2017, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Associate Account Executive posting includes an application form.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 2026 updates included AI traffic analytics for individual links and programmatic creation and management of Bitly Pages through the API and MCP.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bitly announced Matt Young's appointment as CTO on March 19, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Bitly case-study page lists Salesforce and Marketo in its integrations section and says Bitly chose Qualified's conversational marketing platform.
